description:
Decode a JWT and return its header + payload. Does NOT verify the signature.

Returns: JSON with decoded { header, payload, signature } sections of the JWT.
Example input: {"token":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjMifQ.abc"}
On error, includes hint: `token` must be a compact JWT with three base64url-encoded parts separated by dots.
name: jwt_decode
title: Decode JWT
